weights._comment: Deterministic value score weights. Sum of these six keys = 1.0. Editable here without touching code — re-run `python scripts/ingest.py` to apply.

normalization._comment: Per-destination min-max scoring lives in ingest.py. These controls shape edge cases.
normalization._price_per_gb_cap_comment: Plans above this USD/GB are clipped to the cap when normalizing price (prevents tiny-data plans from dominating the price axis).
normalization._unlimited_nominal_data_gb_comment: Used only for computing an indicative price-per-GB figure for display on unlimited plans; unlimited plans are excluded from price-per-GB aggregation and from the 'cheapest by price/GB' ranking.
normalization._validity_cap_comment: Validity normalized against this cap (90 days = full marks). Longer validities do not score beyond the cap.

reliability._comment: Provider reliability baselines (0-1). No free reliability data source exists, so all providers start at 1.0 and can be tuned manually. Deterministic and transparent.

_value_score_threshold_comment: Plans scoring below this are excluded from destination ranked lists (0 = keep everything).
